_comment: Generated by hand from extension/app.js, updated through 2.1.2. `tests` lists node:test names in extension/tests/. Run `node extension/scripts/check-registry.js` to verify active features have at least one passing test — see docs/final-results.md for current results.

features.name: Bookmarks (folders + quick access)
tests: createDefaultTree returns a tree findNode can navigate from the root
findNode returns null for an id that doesn't exist
insertNode adds a new bookmark under the given parent and persists in the tree
insertNode with no url creates a folder (children array, no url)
insertNode returns null when the parent doesn't exist
updateNode changes title/url in place without touching the id
moveNode relocates a node from its old parent to a new one
removeNode deletes a leaf bookmark
removeNode deletes an entire folder subtree at once
removeNode on the synthetic root (no parent) is a safe no-op
features.notes: On the web dashboard this persists to Nestpane's own localStorage-backed tree (lib/bookmarks-store.js), not the browser's native bookmarks — no web page can access those on any browser. The native chrome.bookmarks.* path itself is still untested.

features.name: Reminders / notifications
features.knownLimitation: A4 in docs/AUDIT.md — only fires while a new-tab page is open; no background service worker exists to fire reminders when every new-tab tab is closed.

features.name: Google Drive sync
tests: no conflict on first-ever sync when remote is empty
no conflict when remote matches what we last knew about
no conflict when remote equals the payload we're about to push (our own echo)
conflict when another device advanced the remote past what we last knew, and it differs from our push
concrete scenario: device A pushes, device B (stale) tries to push over it
after reconciling, push proceeds when local is newer than the remote
after reconciling, push proceeds when local exactly ties the remote
after reconciling, push is skipped only when the remote is strictly newer
regression: this device's existing, newer local data must still push even on the first sync of a session
new-browser restore scenario: fresh install with no local data pulls the cloud backup instead of pushing over it
reconcileOnConnect: first login on a new browser ALWAYS pulls cloud backup even if local was touched before login
reconcileOnConnect: first login when no cloud backup exists pushes local state to seed Drive
reconcileOnConnect: already-synced browser compares timestamps accurately
features.notes: Conflict-detection logic is unit tested; the full push/pull network flow is not.

features.name: AI (Ask AI / Smart Organize / daily briefing, BYOK)
Storage schema versioning & migration framework
tests: runMigrations is a no-op when already at the current version
runMigrations advances a never-versioned (v0) dataset to current
runMigrations treats a missing fromVersion as 0
runMigrations rolls back and leaves original data untouched if a step throws

features.name: Cross-browser manifest merge (Firefox target)
tests: merges new top-level keys from the delta onto the base
deep-merges nested objects instead of replacing the whole branch
array values in the delta replace the base array, not merge element-wise
keys starting with underscore are dropped (delta-file documentation, not manifest content)
does not mutate the base object

features.name: Note/journal autosave + flush-on-hide
tests: schedule fires exactly once after the delay elapses
rapid repeated scheduling collapses to a single trailing call with the latest args
flush runs the pending call immediately and prevents the timer from firing again
flush with nothing scheduled is a safe no-op
cancel drops the pending call without ever running it
isPending reflects whether a call is currently scheduled
the exact failure scenario this was built for: a tab torn down mid-edit still persists the last edit
registry.flushAll flushes every registered debounce, not just the first
registry.flushAll is harmless when nothing is pending anywhere

features.name: Web dashboard (nestpane.kneeraazon.com/dashboard/, no install)
features.notes: Build script runs clean and output is syntax/HTML-validated, but nothing end-to-end has been verified in an actual browser — none was available this session.

features.name: Google sign-in on the web dashboard (plain OAuth2 redirect)
features.notes: Requires a redirect URI registered in Google Cloud Console that this session could not add — see docs/browsers/dashboard.md §3. Code is written and syntax-checked, not functionally verified.

features.name: Shared HTML-escape / safe-URL helpers
tests: escH escapes all five HTML-significant characters
escH returns empty string for falsy input
escH neutralizes an attribute-breakout attempt using single quotes
safeUrl allows http/https and assumes https when no scheme given
safeUrl rejects javascript: URIs
safeUrl rejects empty/garbage input

features.name: Bidirectional [[Wiki-Links]] & live backlinks
tests: extractWikiLinks parses unique [[Target]] references in order
resolveWikiLink resolves notes, tasks, bookmarks, and journal dates case-insensitively
findBacklinks finds all notes, tasks, and journal entries referencing a target title

features.name: 7-Day rolling snapshot time machine
tests: summarizePayload counts active notes, tasks, bookmarks, habits, and journal entries
recordDailySnapshot deduplicates same-day snapshots and caps at maxSnapshots
